name: CUDA Tile-and-Bin Implementation
definition: A CUDA pipeline partitioning the canvas into tiles and assigning primitives to tiles they overlap, using one thread block per tile for pixel-level parallelism.
summary: The CUDA Tile-and-Bin Implementation is a parallelization strategy for 2D bitmap rendering that partitions the image into tiles, explicitly manages tile-primitive mapping on the CPU, and stages parameters in shared memory for cooperative compositing.
